lines: 属以拦的子孙、耶歇的儿子示迦尼对以斯拉说：「我们在此地娶了外邦女子为妻，
干犯了我们的神，然而以色列人还有指望。
Shecaniah the son of Jehiel
one of the sons of Elam
answered Ezra
“We have trespassed against our God
and have married foreign women of the peoples of the land. Yet now there is hope for Israel concerning this thing.
